title: Witness Perk-tection
premise: A pelican in witness protection has one weakness: loyalty points.
tone: Dry absurdity. The pelican is serious; the barista is practical.

cast.name: Anonymous
cast.description: A tired pelican attempting to look inconspicuous. Navy overalls; expressive long beak.

cast.name: Barista
cast.description: A patient human café worker with dark wavy hair, a rust shirt, and a teal apron.

scenes.title: The alias
scenes.setting: Portrait café interior. Both characters face one another; the café sign sits above them. Keep their faces large enough for a phone.

scenes.title: The announcement
scenes.setting: Hold the two-shot. The barista calls the order. The pelican glances around and leans toward the barista.

dialogue.text: Please keep your voice down. I am in witness protection.

scenes.title: The weakness
scenes.setting: The barista indicates a loyalty card. Let the pelican’s hesitation land before the reply.

dialogue.text: Then why did you give me your loyalty card?
Nine stamps. I am not starting over.

scenes.title: The evidence
scenes.setting: Keep both faces visible. Hold eye contact after the barista points out the photograph. End on a silent beat.

dialogue.text: It has your photograph on it.
That was before I became Anonymous.
